g.text: Violence against women is not an Indian problem.
It is a world problem. Here is the evidence.
This is a presentation about violence against women
and girls — how big it is, where it happens,
why it keeps happening, and what actually stops it.
Built from WHO, UNODC and UN Women data,
ALL FIGURES SOURCED — SEE FINAL SLIDE
And why does it keep happening —
in rich countries and poor ones,
in war zones and in peacetime?
women — nearly 1 in 3 worldwide — have faced
intimate-partner or sexual violence in their lifetime.

of global aid goes to preventing violence

Each turn of the loop makes the next one easier.
When punishment is rare, violence is rational:
why stop doing what costs you nothing?

that they will get away with it.
Psychology's name for it: moral disengagement.
